meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: Claude 会先检测你机器上已有的 OpenClaw 安装,读出其中的身份、频道凭据、定时任务等配置,再用对话方式陪你逐个决定哪些内容迁到 NanoClaw v2、放到哪里,确认后才真正应用。
howto.when: 当你说出 “migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”、“import from openclaw” 时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude detects your existing OpenClaw install, reads identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and other config, then walks you through migrating to NanoClaw v2 as a conversation, showing proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".
